chalisa.do1: Fixing his mind on the feet of Śrī Guru and holding Hanumān in meditation, the servant Snehī Kalyāṇa writes the Bālājī Chālīsā.
chalisa.do2: Hanumān, famed throughout the world, giver of boons and remover of distress, the Lord Bālājī, has appeared at Mehandipur.
chalisa.cau1: Victory to you, Hanumān, divine Bālājī. All three deities have appeared here: ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: Pretarāja, the mighty Bhairava, who is kotwāl (guardian of the town) and captain, and Hanumān. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: He has taken incarnation at Mehandipur and has delivered his devotees. ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: He has appeared here in the form of a child, here where those in trouble come. ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: Ḍākinīs, śākinīs and female jinns, masāns (cremation-ground spirits), witches, ghosts and she-ghosts: ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: all these flee in fear of him; here the exorcists and bhopās (folk priests who cast out spirits) are dismayed. ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: Every binding spell and charm is cut; the messengers gather and rejoice. ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: Your court is true; whoever comes to you for refuge gains great happiness. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: He is an abode of beauty, splendour and strength beyond compare, and before him are Sītā and Śrī Rāma. ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: His golden crown shines with the splendour of its gems; everyone's hopes are fulfilled. ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: The virtuous Mahant Gaṇeśapurī became his good servant, steeped in the colour of Rāma. ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: What wondrous skill was shown, as though a light had been kindled in the Kali age! ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: High flags and banners fly in the sky; the golden finials rise lofty in the world. ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: The drum of dharma and truth resounds; Sītā and Rāma, and Śiva, reign there amid cries of victory. ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: Coming, he whirled the club and cudgel; blows of the stick fall on ghosts and jinns. ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: With Śrī Rāma, Lakṣmaṇa and Sītā in his heart, Hanumān, who brings good, has appeared in the form of a child. ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: Victory to you, resolute god Hanumān; the Purī family serves you. ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: With laddus, cūrmā, sugar-candy and dried fruits, O God, I put in my plea and petition. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: Bālājī is merciful in every way; Bālājī, remover of distress, has appeared. ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: Every person cries victory to Bābā; millions of people have come to your door. ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: In your childhood you swallowed the sun and made all three worlds dark. ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: The gods made a very great entreaty; seeing their distress, you let the sun go. ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: Leaping across the ocean, you brought news of Sītā; for Lakṣmaṇa's sake you brought the sañjīvanī herb. ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: You are the sun of the life of Lakṣmaṇa, Rāma's younger brother; you are the son of Śiva, the son of Mother Añjanī, and Śrī Rāma's servant. ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: Son of Kesarī, destroyer of the sorrow of worldly existence, delight of Śrī Rāma, you are ever the abode of joy. ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: You are dear as life to Sītā and Śrī Rāma. When the devotees call out to Bābā: ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: Lord, destroyer of distress and sorrow, have mercy, O treasury of grace. ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: When one remembers the child-form that brings good, he fulfils one's wishes and tasks. ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: You are the giver of the eight siddhis and the nine treasures; devotees come in great numbers. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: Rich and poor offer dried fruits and choice sweets as gifts. ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: Every day, in ways all their own, Ṛddhi and the Siddhis dance at his door. ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: As soon as the order on the petition is given, Bhairava seizes the ghosts there and then. ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: The kotwāl and captain, Bhairava, bears the sword, and Pretarāja brings good in distress. ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: Brother, the binding spells and charms of those who serve are cut. ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: Śrī Rāma's servant, the Lord as a child, Hanumān has appeared at Mehandipur. ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: Those who come to Bālājī have the sins of birth after birth destroyed. ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: Taking the holy water, they go home and, made pure, rejoice. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: Cruel and hard distress flees; he shows the way along the path of truth and dharma. ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: Whoever recites the Chālīsā a hundred times, the Lord of Speech is pleased with him. ॥39॥
chalisa.cau40: Kalyāṇa Snehī sings it with love and gains happiness, prosperity, ṛddhi and siddhi. ॥40॥
chalisa.do3: Knowing my mind is dull, forgive me, O mine of virtues; deliverer from distress, forgive me, your servant Snehī Kalyāṇa.
